status: Supplemental unshipped reference pack. Current content/worlds.md and DECISIONS.md are authoritative: new worlds use exactly three places. Asset IDs and six-image sheets do not define runtime content; missing authored source products still need downloading.

supporting_references.purpose: Annotated axis reference only, not the globe texture. Preserve for matching longitude direction and full extent.

nasa-jpl.terms: NASA/JPL educational and informational image-use permission; preserve the full per-image credit, respect separately identified rights, and imply no endorsement. This is not a blanket CC licence or a claim that all partner contributions are public domain.

esa-hubble.terms: CC BY 4.0 under ESA/Hubble policy; retain the complete credit beside the image and link the source and licence. Derivatives here are resizing/recompression only.

tanya-cc-by.terms: The publisher explicitly credits Tanya Oleksuik and states CC BY, without a version or licence link. Preserve the exact credit and source statement. Do not relabel this NASA-only or silently assign a CC version; confirm the licence version/link before production promotion.

assets.title: Jupiter cloud map
assets.processing: Two-filter near-infrared/blue colour mosaic approximating visible colour; full-extent cylindrical map, no labels or grid in this file.
assets.caption_draft: Cloud stripes and storms wrap around Jupiter. This map records the clouds seen in December 2000.
assets.use_notes: Preferred cloud-skin candidate. Planetocentric latitude. Companion axis reference is retained separately. Confirm the longitude system, seam and runtime UV orientation before placing markers. Atmospheric features drift; this is not fixed solid terrain.

assets.title: Europa Voyager mosaic
assets.mission_instrument: Voyager imagery / USGS mosaic; individual camera and dates not specified by landing page
assets.processing: Publisher's cleaned-up grayscale Voyager mosaic; uneven spatial resolution and baked illumination.
assets.caption_draft: Spacecraft pictures show lines and markings across Europa's icy surface. This map shows brightness, not height.
assets.use_notes: Provisional globe candidate at native 1440 x 720; do not upscale or invent colour. Landing page does not specify longitude origin/direction or control network. Verify at least Pwyll and Tyre against an authoritative coordinate reference before integration. Do not derive elevation from brightness.

assets.title: The Great Red Spot
assets.processing: Archive colour image; exact colour calibration not specified by this caption.
assets.caption_draft: The big oval is a swirling storm. It is called the Great Red Spot.
assets.use_notes: Recognisable primary subject. Match any marker to the dated texture's storm, not a modern longitude. Avoid repeating obsolete size/age superlatives from historical captions.

assets.title: Stripes of clouds
assets.caption_draft: Jupiter wears light and dark stripes. They are clouds, with winds blowing through them.
assets.use_notes: Good whole-world introduction and band subject. Not a landable surface or a single point feature. Archive release dates differ across republished pages; this record uses the Photojournal entry.

assets.title: Storms around the pole
assets.processing: Infrared thermal composite; false colours represent radiant heat, not visible red/yellow clouds.
assets.caption_draft: A heat-seeing camera reveals storms around Jupiter's north pole. These colours help us see heat.
assets.use_notes: Nine cyclones are shown in this historical product. Do not promise a current storm count or treat the heat image as the visible globe texture. Individual acquisition dates are not supplied by the caption.

assets.title: Glowing polar lights
assets.mission_instrument: Hubble / WFC3 optical and STIS ultraviolet
assets.processing: Composite combining optical and ultraviolet observations from different years; auroral colour is a visualisation of invisible ultraviolet light.
assets.caption_draft: Jupiter has glowing polar lights. This picture adds ultraviolet light that our eyes cannot see.
assets.use_notes: Show as an archive phenomenon, never as a simultaneous naked-eye photograph or ordinary blue paint on the planet. Preserve full NASA, ESA credit and CC BY 4.0/source links.

assets.title: A moon's shadow
assets.credit: Image data: NASA/JPL-Caltech/SwRI/MSSS, Image processing by Tanya Oleksuik, © CC BY
assets.processing: Enhanced-colour spacecraft image processed by Tanya Oleksuik.
assets.caption_draft: The dark circle is a shadow. Jupiter's moon Io blocked the sunlight there.
assets.use_notes: Strong visual subject, conditional production licence metadata. The shadow is a transient event, not a crater or a ring marker. Retain the publisher's stated observation date and time zone; no UTC conversion has been inferred here.

assets.title: Jupiter turns
assets.processing: Nine true-colour frames taken at different times, arranged as a sequence; not nine planets.
assets.caption_draft: These pictures show the same Jupiter turning. Watch the red storm move around the planet.
assets.use_notes: Prefer for an optional rotation explanation. A nine-panel image is weak as a tiny badge; do not force it into a six-point surface hunt or present it as one instant.

assets.title: Io and its moving shadow
assets.processing: Multi-panel false-colour UV/violet composite and separate plume inset, sharpened by the original publisher.
assets.caption_draft: Io moves past Jupiter in these pictures. Its shadow travels across the clouds.
assets.use_notes: Backup for jupiter-io-shadow if the preferred citizen-processed image's precise CC licence cannot be established. Published NASA/JPL/STScI attribution; no separate third-party copyright notice in the caption. More visually complicated and includes an Io plume inset; do not describe this as one exposure or true colour.

assets.title: Pwyll crater
assets.caption_draft: An impact made this crater in Europa's ice. Material from below was thrown around it.
assets.use_notes: Useful named landmark and texture-alignment reference. Caption coordinates are legacy published values, not a newly verified modern control point.

placement.coordinate_basis: feature position from archive caption; latitude convention unspecified

assets.title: Jumbled ice at Conamara
assets.processing: Monochrome mosaic mixing context imagery and higher-resolution insets from different encounters.
assets.caption_draft: These pieces of ice moved and turned. They look like a jumbled puzzle.
assets.use_notes: Do not describe this as a single exposure or proof of an exposed ocean. The physical material below the blocks is interpreted, not directly photographed as open water.

placement.coordinate_basis: image centre, not the named feature's IAU centre; latitude convention unspecified

assets.title: Crossing icy ridges
assets.observation_date: Galileo orbit 4; date not specified in caption
assets.caption_draft: Long ridges cross Europa's icy surface. Some lines cut across older lines.
assets.use_notes: Region, not a named permanent point. Do not repeat the historical 'highest resolution ever' claim as current fact.

placement.coordinate_basis: image centre from caption; latitude convention unspecified

assets.title: Tyre's impact rings
assets.processing: Three-image false-colour composite highlighting shape and composition differences.
assets.caption_draft: An impact left rings in Europa's ice. The colours are changed to help show different materials.
assets.use_notes: Named landmark. Do not mistake these surface rings for orbiting planetary rings. Preserve false-colour explanation.

placement.coordinate_basis: feature position from archive caption; latitude convention unspecified

assets.title: The bright Agenor band
assets.caption_draft: A bright band stretches across the ice. Its name is Agenor Linea.
assets.use_notes: Broad band shown in a low-resolution regional context. Coordinates describe the image centre; resolve a representative point on the actual band before authoring a marker.

placement.coordinate_basis: image centre, not Agenor's feature centre; latitude convention unspecified

assets.title: Europa's icy freckles
assets.processing: Composite combining higher-resolution detail with lower-resolution colour from a different encounter; not a single exposure. Colour calibration not specified by this caption.
assets.caption_draft: Dark spots and shallow pits dot the ice. Scientists call the dark spots freckles.
assets.use_notes: A distinct surface subject, replacing the overlapping Thera/Thrace context candidate. Caption places this in the northern hemisphere but gives no centre coordinates; research the original observation footprint before marker placement. Ice upwelling is an interpretation, not a directly photographed exposed ocean or evidence of life.

placement.coordinate_basis: northern hemisphere only; no centre coordinates in caption
